senses.gloss:
तोक तोक,
 I. n.
 1. Offspring, Chr. 291, 14 = Rigv. i. 64, 14.
 2. Child, [] Bhāg. P. 2, 7, 27.
 II. m. in वराह-तोक, A young boar, Bhāg. P. 3, 13, 18.
 --Cf. ved. तुच्, Offspring; त्वक्ष्, τέκνον (= A.S. thegn, thegen; O.H.G. degan, servus); τίκτω, ἔτεκον, τοκάς; probably Goth. thius, thivi; A.S. theowa-man.
तोक्म तोक्म (akin to तोक), m. Green barley, Bhāg. P. 4, 21, 2.
